leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface to define the shape of filter and sort state.
Initialize a typed state object with default values for filtering and sorting.
Implement handler functions to update specific filter and sort properties.
Apply type annotations to ensure state updates are type-safe.
Integrate the typed state model into a simple application structure.
Manipulate the state by calling handlers in response to simulated user actions.
Configure a component to render UI controls bound to the typed state.
lessonTitle: Build typed filter and sort state model
